value.rationale: The exact number of distinguishable outputs of a natural k=2,ell=2 binary multi-strand reconstruction channel is a motivated coding-theoretic invariant explicitly defined in 2021 primary work. The theorem classifies every attainable four-count observation at every length, isolates the endpoint-flow parity obstruction and constant-strand exception, and determines a sharp maximum zero-error code cardinality. This resolves a whole infinite family and is not an arbitrary finite census or routine substitution.
